verdict.rationale: Omarchy ships OpenCode and Claude Code as default agent harnesses and sets one up on first boot. It also wires crash notifications so the agent can examine the crash dump, diagnose the problem and help report the bug, which is a concrete case of AI-generated insights from the user's own data inside the product. Beyond crash dumps, though, insights depend on general-purpose third-party agents rather than built-in analysis features. Missing for 10: native AI insights or suggestions across user data beyond crash dumps, proactive suggestion surfaces, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the crash-diagnosis flow.
